title: 1RB0RE_0RC0RF_1LD1RA_1RE0LD_0LB1RC_1LE---: the rebuild map run to rebuild 6,000 stays inside the law; first frontier cases in Lean
text: The map is exact arithmetic in two cases: normally the unread bits of the counter move to the bottom and a run of about 7J ones goes on top; after a big word (a drop) the top of the counter is all zeros, and those stretches, read whole by the automaton, are the long words. The list never runs out before the counter (every word needs at most 3J cells of list). The closest approach to the top of the counter was rebuild 987 (75,936 of 105,958 bits); from rebuild 988 to 6,000 no word reads more than 7% of it, with the single block at 2,919,690 cells. In Lean, the frontiers of the case analysis are stated for all parameters, and 13 of the 516 cases are proved.
